reason: I already get my matcha at Matchaful most mornings and I know it's good. A café inside another place with dessert-flavored lattes doesn't tell me anything about the matcha itself, so I'd just keep walking to my usual spot.
objection: Is the matcha actually good quality, or is it hidden under strawberry cheesecake syrup? Nothing here says what matcha they use.
would_change_my_mind: Telling me the matcha's grade and where it comes from, or a free taste of a plain matcha latte on my way to the train.
